name: Describe Image
description: Writes a prompt, a caption or tags from a picture with a language model that reads images.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: Sent at most 1024 pixels on a side, to a model that takes images.

inputs.name: style
inputs.label: Style
inputs.description: What to write about the picture. The list is the prompt templates of the describe family (Fugue's own and the files in the data folder's prompts folder), filled in when Fugue starts.

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.label: Also
inputs.description: Anything more the model should do, such as "ignore the background".

inputs.name: language
inputs.label: Language
inputs.description: The language to write in, such as English. Empty: the model's own, usually English.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: Unset: any ready text model. It must read images.
